state.revision_summary: Retained the chalcogenide and heavy-element polarity transfer skill with the same rules and parameters. Replaced the light-element counter-hypothesis with an oxide-covalent counter-hypothesis that keeps the low-Z and binary penalties but replaces halide with oxide, which dominates the target pool and is typically covalent. Both skills use two-to-four mechanistically interpretable rules, and neither uses placeholder keys or target outcomes.
